alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:7c9d2bb0-a.title: Post-Training Research Scientist
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:7c9d2bb0-a.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE This role sits at the frontier of our research agenda. You will pursue open problems at the intersection of post-training methodology and performant inference, and then collaborate with research engineering to translate findings into production systems. A meaningful portion of your time will be dedicated to research that deepens our understanding of how models learn, alignment, and architectural efficiency — questions that may not have immediate product application. The remainder will be directed toward research that solves concrete problems for Baseten's platform and customers, who are the fastest growing AI companies in the world like Cursor, Lovable, and Notion. We are looking for someone with sharp research taste and genuine creative instinct for problem selection. Someone who can identify questions that matter, design clean experiments to answer them, and push the state of the art. The environment here is not theoretical, but rather research that can be validated with eager customers who are serving billions of tokens a second. RECENT RESEARCH - Towards infinite context windows: neural KV cache compaction https://www.baseten.co/research/towards-infinite-context-windows-neural-kv-cache-compaction/ - Dense, on-policy or both? https://www.baseten.co/research/dense-on-policy-or-both/ - Repeated kv cache for long-running agents https://www.baseten.co/research/repeated-kv-cache-for-long-running-agents/ - Distillation without the dark – replicating black-box on-policy distillation on Baseten https://www.baseten.co/research/distillation-without-the-dark/ RESPONSIBILITIES - Define and pursue a research agenda spanning both foundational and applied work, with the applied component connected to Baseten's platform and customer needs. - Design and execute rigorous experiments, frequently at meaningful scale (multi-node, trillion parameter models). - Work with customers to translate domain-specific requirements into research problems, where relevant to your agenda. - Publish at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and establish Baseten's research presence. - Collaborate with model performance and training infrastructure teams to bridge research findings and inference production systems. - Mentor junior researchers and shape the technical direction of the research organization as it grows. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Master’s or PhD research depth in machine learning, with first-author publications at top venues - Demonstrated ability to move from theory through implementation to empirical results — not exclusively theoretical or exclusively engineering work - Judgment about problem selection, the ability to distinguish research that advances a metric from research that changes how systems are built - Willingness to operate in a startup environment where the majority of research informs product decisions, with timelines measured in months rather than years - Background spanning multiple research areas (e.g., both interpretability and RL, or both systems and training methodology) - Track record of open-source contributions or community building in ML research OUR VIEW ON TALENT Many of the labs that exist today run a credentialist talent model. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). jobgether-jobgether:lever:43fcf927-3ada-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Germany. This is a high-impact Solutions Architect opportunity focused on bringing cutting-edge Voice AI technology to Arabic-speaking markets. You will serve as a hands-on technical partner for enterprise customers, owning implementations from initial discovery through production deployment. The role combines customer-facing solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, technical delivery, and post-launch support. You will design solutions around real-world customer environments, technical constraints, and data-residency requirements while building reusable patterns that can accelerate future engagements. As the first dedicated technical presence for the region, you will also shape the regional playbook and influence product development through direct customer insights. The environment is fast-moving, AI-first, globally distributed, and highly collaborative, with significant autonomy and technical ownership. Own the technical design and delivery of enterprise customer implementations across the target region, from initial kickoff through production cutover and scaling. Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical evaluations for prospective customers in partnership with commercial teams. Design practical solutions that align with customer technology stacks, business requirements, operational constraints, and data-residency needs. Serve as a trusted technical advisor for Arabic-speaking customers, communicating effectively with both engineering teams and business or executive stakeholders. Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events, and regional engagements, helping establish strong technical relationships. Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, deployment playbooks, and automation that can be applied across future customer projects. Translate lessons learned from implementations and evaluations into scalable technical approaches that shorten time to customer value. Bring customer feedback to Product and Research teams, particularly insights into Arabic-language model performance across different dialects and production use cases. Support complex post-onboarding technical cases and regional escalations, helping maintain strong customer outcomes as deployments scale. Contribute to expanding technical coverage across additional time zones as the global team grows. Balance customer delivery, pre-sales, technical enablement, documentation, product feedback, and escalations according to business priorities. Operate with an AI-first mindset, continuously experimenting with modern AI tools and incorporating them into technical discovery, development, solution design, and delivery workflows. Requirements Native or professional-level Arabic fluency combined with excellent written and spoken English. Based in the MENA region or elsewhere in EMEA, in a location where the relevant employment infrastructure supports hiring. At least 4 years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in a customer-facing technical role. Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust , or a comparable language. Proven experience leading production technical deployments from solution design through implementation and cutover. Demonstrated ability to scope complex technical initiatives, break them into manageable stages, and drive successful delivery. Strong understanding of solution architecture, APIs, software development, system integration, and production deployment practices. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:3bdd03c3-bd2.description: Ads Quality Rater Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world's largest ad evaluation programs and want you to join our team! As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and rate internet ads to improve which ads are presented to end users. In other words, you will provide feedback to the AI ​​program on how good or bad its ad suggestions are based on the user's keywords. You will review ads in both English and German. This position is ideal for people who: - surf the Internet daily - Use search engines regularly - know what Internet users are searching for based on a few keywords - enjoy researching topics online - looking for a flexible and entertaining part-time job Project details Job title: Ads Quality Rater (m/f/d) Remuneration: Variable depending on the complexity of the task Location: Remote (Germany only) Working hours: 5-20 hours per week, flexible scheduling Start Date: Immediately Employment relationship: Freelancer/self-employed: self-employed contractor Project duration: long-term There is no formal interview for this job! No calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether or not you got the job. Instead, you will be guided through a self-directed and automated recruitment process. IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity verification checks to ensure that everyone who joins the team is genuine, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid misunderstandings, do not use IP obfuscation programs (such as VPNs).
